edition in force & state drawn in proportion to its 2018 commercial energy use within the census division (EIA SEDS); construction year drawn uniformly within the survey's construction period; edition: the newest in force in that state by that year; a renovated system takes the edition of a year drawn from 2000, or its period's start if later, to 2018 & drawn per building per imputation; the state tables are treated as fixed administrative counts (no parameter draw) \\
BAS linkage and recording & the shares of knowledge graphs that link all, none or part of their streams, and each class's linked share among those that declare it, from the 37 reference-set knowledge graphs with data  & each imputation re-estimates these shares on a resample, with replacement, of the 45 knowledge graphs and draws the share of a class that fewer than five declare from Beta(1 +\allowbreak{} linked, 1 +\allowbreak{} unlinked); each building's linkage is then drawn \\

monitoring-clause recording & code text: 90.1-2013 \S{}8.4.3 records every 15 min and keeps 36 months & read from the code text (no imputation); subject to compliance c \\
EIA-imputed control answers & buildings of the same type, size class and construction period that reported the answer (at least 10, or a coarser group otherwise), for the BAS and its heating, cooling and lighting control, smart thermostat, occupancy sensors, demand-controlled ventilation, VAV, dedicated outdoor-air system and daylight harvesting; when the BAS answer was imputed, its control answers are redrawn with it & redrawn from a donor in every imputation \\
